story.iWant: to know if axis position may be lost
story.soThat: I can re-home before continuing operation

tasks.task: Define position loss data structures - poslos_flags bitmap, homed_flags bitmap, ERR_POSLOS (E037), MSG_POSITION_UNKNOWN
Implement PositionLossDetector module - position_loss.c/h with init, set, get, get_all, on_estop functions
Initialize POSLOS on power cycle - call from safety_monitor_init(), mark servos POSLOS, publish events
Integrate with E-stop handler - call position_loss_on_estop() after E-stop, publish events for servos only
Implement CMD_POSOK command handler - parse POSOK [axis], clear flags, return to IDLE
Block motion on POSLOS - check in MOVE, MOVR, VEL handlers, reject with ERR_POSLOS
Update STAT command for POSLOS - add POSLOS:XYZAB field
Clear POSLOS on homing complete - position_loss_on_homing_complete() hook for Story 4.13

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Power Cycle Position Loss - all axes UNHOMED, servo axes POSLOS on boot
E-Stop Position Loss - servo axes flagged POSLOS after E-stop, EVENT POSLOS published
Position Loss Event Publication - EVENT POSLOS axis published, axis state ERROR
CMD_POSOK Single Axis - POSOK X clears flag, returns IDLE, responds OK
CMD_POSOK All Axes - POSOK clears all flags, returns OK
Motion Blocked on POSLOS - MOVE/MOVR/VEL rejected with ERR_POSLOS MSG_POSITION_UNKNOWN
STAT Shows POSLOS - response includes POSLOS:XYZAB field (1=lost, 0=OK)
Homing Clears POSLOS - successful homing clears flag, marks axis HOMED
Stepper Axis Handling - C,D marked UNHOMED only (no POSLOS), require HOME not POSOK

constraints.constraint: Header-Only Configuration: All configurable values MUST be in header files. Use CMD_POSOK not "POSOK", ERR_POSLOS not "E037".
Module Pattern: Create position_loss.c/h in safety_monitor component following brake_controller structure.
STAT Extension: Add POSLOS:XYZAB field following BRAKES:XYZAB pattern (lines 388-398).
Error Code: Add ERR_POSLOS as E037 following ERR_BRAKE_AUTO (E035), ERR_AXIS_NO_BRAKE (E036) sequence.
Servo axes (X,Y,Z,A,B) get POSLOS; stepper axes (C,D) and discrete (E) do not.
EVENT POSLOS axis format: "EVENT POSLOS X" per axis affected.

interfaces.interface: Initialize module, set all servo axes POSLOS, all axes UNHOMED
Mark all servo axes POSLOS, publish events
Clear POSLOS and set HOMED for axis

tests.standards: ESP-IDF Unity test framework. Unit tests in component test/ directories. Integration tests in firmware/test/integration/. Use safety_monitor_inject_test_state() for hardware-free testing. Follow existing test patterns in test_brake_controller.c.
